integrity: All-primes classification proved algebraically; independent audit not performed. No claims about an unnormalized Hessian in characteristic 2 or 3.
scientific_limitations: Geometric singular points for the explicitly normalized integral Klein Hessian sextic only. Characteristic-seven analytic branch and delta-invariants are not determined. Whole Elkies chapter inaccessible; possible unrecognized published overlap. The archive eligibility date is Koike’s verified initial arXiv posting in 2015; earlier Elkies publication is established to year 1999, but not a first-publication day.
title: The primitive Klein Hessian sextic is smooth away from characteristics two and seven
